source.text: P1 Agent Expansion: Creator cohort with CIP distribution and Validator cohort with VRP rewards. Add two new agent pools to the M3 simulation: (1) Creator cohort funded by CIP distributions with content-quality-weighted recirculation, (2) Validator cohort funded by VRP rewards with stake-weighted distribution. Tokenomics persona obligations: emissions schedule for CIP/VRP payouts, incentive source traceability per agent class, vesting/unlock schedule for validator rewards, governance authority over reward parameters. Stories: US-Z1-M3-07, US-Z1-M3-08.
